attchmntText: Unitech Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Unitech Limited’s Board approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Statutory auditors issued a disclaimer of conclusion on the standalone results. The report cites a material uncertainty regarding the company's ability to continue as a going concern due to eroded net worth, losses, and pending litigation. The Resolution Framework filed with the Supreme Court remains unapproved. Auditors could not verify investments in subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates valued at Rs. 972,15.70 lakhs due to lack of impairment assessment. Recoverability of loans and trade receivables totaling Rs. 4,496,30.97 lakhs and Rs. 45,55.06 lakhs respectively could not be confirmed. Other unverified items include corporate guarantees of Rs. 2,332,74.34 lakhs, amounts due from GNIDA of Rs. 183,39.80 lakhs, and various reconciliations for statutory dues and bank balances.

attchmntText: Unitech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Details of Authorized Persons under Regulation 30(5) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015'.
